decision_timing: Frozen after Stage 4 established an image-specific safe final unique-owner gain and before either crossover prefix was executed
primary_question: Does the row-0 coordinate history still affect the row-5 object choice after rows 1 through 3 are identical, or is the effect mediated by the later row-4 geometry?

frozen_rows.rows_one_through_three: The native and sampled Stage 3 trajectories have exactly equal raw token identifiers for all three rows.

required_checks: All four prefixes contain exactly five complete nine-token rows and do not contain target owner 211764.
Rows 1 through 3 are raw-token identical in all four prefixes.
The row-0 pair has the same physical owner, description, syntax, and token count and differs only in four coordinate tokens.
The row-4 pair has the same physical owner, description, syntax, and token count and differs only in coordinate tokens.
The two frozen endpoints reproduce the Stage 4 row-5 owner choice and final owner sets from raw artifacts; only the two crossover arms require new generation.
Prompt, media, image grid, model, configuration, and source file identities remain frozen.
primary_outcome: The strict physical owner of the first complete row after the five-row forced prefix.
secondary_outcome: Natural-terminal strict owner set, duplicate owners, malformed rows, unresolved rows, and warnings under the same total 512-token trajectory budget.

interpretation_rules.persistent_row_zero_effect: sampled-row-zero plus native-row-four retrieves target 211764 while native-row-zero plus sampled-row-four follows duplicate owner 205108.
interpretation_rules.row_four_sufficient_or_mediating: native-row-zero plus sampled-row-four retrieves target 211764 while sampled-row-zero plus native-row-four follows duplicate owner 205108.
interpretation_rules.joint_interaction: Neither crossover arm retrieves target 211764 while the sampled-row-zero plus sampled-row-four endpoint does.
interpretation_rules.other_or_unresolved: A crossover selects another owner, fails a frozen identity/prefix check, or contains malformed or ambiguous first-row evidence.

allowed_claim: An image-specific causal decomposition of whether the row-0 and row-4 coordinate histories are sufficient alone or only jointly for the row-5 target choice.
forbidden_claims: smooth geometric meaning of coordinate changes
next_step_rule: Only after an interpretable crossover result may one matched same-magnitude different-direction coordinate perturbation be frozen at the implicated row.
